snippet.title: Dying Breed Release Trailer - OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Dying Breeed is OUT NOW!

Steam: https://shorturl.at/djoFX

Discord: https://discord.gg/HbRmrDezcn

Set in a twisted WW2 reality, Dying Breed blends fast-paced action with strategic decision-making encouraging players to be both cunning and sneaky when necessary.
The world of Dying Breed is filled with shiny energy minerals, evil arch-enemies, zombies, retro-futuristic technologies, underground monsters, and warring factions, complemented by live-action FMVs and a '90s metal soundtrack. 
It's a love letter to 90s RTSs, a tribute to science fiction cult movies, and an homage to game OSTs!
